prompt:
toy-like game art, playful and colourful, like a set of painted vinyl toys in space.
chunky rounded shapes, grotesque proportions: oversized engines, bulbous cockpits,

soft rim light. matte plastic: no gloss, no reflections, no texture noise, no grime.
